text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I took the medicine, but it ain't 
doing shit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, whining about the pain won't fix it 
anyway, so it's only logical to ignore it 
and play some games.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Does this guy think he's safe there? 
He's totally underestimating my aim--

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Dammit, this headache is seriously 
annoying. Tryna keep me from focusin', 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur was plagued by a headache for a 
while after that.
